LESSON: LANGUAGE USE 7.3.1 SIMPLE PAST TENSE (ADDING - ED/- D)

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade one
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.3: Language Use 7.3.1 Simple past tense (adding - ed/- d)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Language Use 7.3.1 Simple past tense (adding - ed/- d), part of Strand 7 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade one General.

Key inquiry question: What did you do in the morning before coming to school? 2. What did your family do last Saturday to keep the home clean?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Language Use 7.3.1 Simple past tense (adding - ed/- d) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Learning to learn: The learner displays self-discipline as they practise sign reading non-decodable words.

Values:
Unity: cooperation is enhanced as the learner collaborates with others in pair or in group activities.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Health education (personal hygiene): is enhanced as the learner acquires relevant information on hygiene.

Link to other learning areas:

Learner is able to relate the concept of sign reading to all learning areas

Suggested Learning Resources:
